def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    accent=min((x for x in cnt if x not in (0, max(cnt))), key=lambda x: cnt[x])
    # Find rare non-background color; background is most common color.
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    accent=min((x for x in cnt if x != bg), key=lambda x: cnt[x])
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==accent]
    mr=min(r for r,c in pts); mc=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in pts}
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
        if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in cells):
          for rr,cc in cells: out[rr][cc]=accent
    return out
